notes: A paint bound to a variable on a VECTOR renders its base colour in screenshots unless the base colour matches the resolved token. Always create bound paints with the resolved colour as the base.
Imported SVG art sits in a group, and groups ignore constraints. Set SCALE on the vectors inside so icon instances resize cleanly.
Button labels share one TEXT property default, Continue. Set the label on each instance.
Pressed red and grey buttons use a white label, black fails on them (2.8 and 2.4 to 1).
Button sets now hug the label with a 120 minimum. Instances set to FILL keep filling.
Hidden sublayers inside an instance are not returned by findOne. Guard for null.
A component set looked up once at the top of a script goes stale after combineAsVariants. Look sets up fresh each time.
A failed use_figma call rolls back everything it did.
Hiding a layer bound to a boolean property flips the property on the instance. The toolbar's first divider shares Type menu.
Switching a horizontal auto layout to vertical keeps its old fixed height and its children's grow. Set the parent to hug and reset each child's grow.
Image fills on the source Login panel sit on a rectangle rotated 180 degrees. Export the rendered node instead of reusing the raw image.
